n-m-e3-s2b-01.title: Ukwenza inombolo phakathi kwepizza eyodwa namapizza amabili ngezingxenyana ezinesihlukanisi esifanayo
n-m-e3-s2b-01.topic: Izingxenyana (izingxenyana ezingafanele nezingxenyana zeyunithi, usayizi wezingxenyana: izingxenyana phakathi kuka-1 no-2)
n-m-e3-s2b-01.goal: Hlola ngezibonelo eziningana ukuthi inombolo engaphezulu yengxenyana enesihlukanisi esifanayo yenza nini ibe likhulu kuno-1 futhi lincane kuno-2, bese usho ukuthi izingxenyana zomkhawulo ziwela hlangothi luphi.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.material: Iqembu likaSeoa lahlukana ngepizza esikwe ngezingcezu ezilinganayo. Uma ipizza eyodwa ihlukaniswa ngokulinganayo ibe yizingcezu ezi-4, ingcezu eyodwa ingu-1/4 wepizza. Sibhala izingcezu ezi-3 njengo-3/4 wepizza nezingcezu ezi-5 njengo-5/4 wepizza. Ingxenyana enenombolo engaphezulu enkulu kunesihlukanisi ibizwa ngokuthi ingxenyana engafanele.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.thinking.0: Ukunquma ukuthi amanani omkhawulo (ncamashi ipizza eyodwa, ncamashi amapizza amabili) ahambisana nesimo yini
n-m-e3-s2b-01.thinking.1: Ukwenza nokuhlola izibonelo ngendlela efanayo ngezihlukanisi eziningana
n-m-e3-s2b-01.thinking.2: Ukubala izibonelo nokuhlola ukuthi azikho eziphuthile noma ezibalwe ngokweqile
n-m-e3-s2b-01.prereq.0: Ukufunda ingxenyana njengesiphelele nengxenye (3 kwezi-4, njll.)
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.prompt: Ipizza eyodwa yahlukaniswa ngokulinganayo yaba yizingcezu ezi-4. Iyiphi kuzingxenyana ezingezansi enkulu kunepizza eyodwa?
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.hint.0: Dweba isithombe, uhlukanise ipizza eyodwa ibe yizingcezu ezi-4, bese ufiphaza inani lezingcezu kokukhethwayo ngakunye.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa eduzane inani lezingcezu epizza eyodwa nenani lezingcezu kokukhethwayo ngakunye.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.r.a: Izingcezu ezi-3 azizange zigcwalise ipizza eyodwa ephelele, kodwa kungenzeka ucabange ukuthi iningi ngokubuka nje inani lezingcezu.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.r.b: Lokhu kucabanga kubala ingxenyana engokufanayo ncamashi nepizza eyodwa njenge-"ngaphezulu kwepizza eyodwa."
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.r.c: Lokhu kucabanga kuthole icala lapho inani lezingcezu likhulu kunenani lezingcezu eziyenza ipizza eyodwa.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.r.d: Lokhu kucabanga kukubone kuningi noma inani lezingcezu lincane. Zingaki izingcezu ezenza ipizza eyodwa?
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.explain: Ipizza eyodwa ingezingcezu ezi-4. Izingcezu ezi-5 yipizza eyodwa (izingcezu ezi-4) nengcezu e-1, ngakho kungaphezulu kwepizza eyodwa. Izingcezu ezi-4 ncamashi yipizza eyodwa, nezingcezu ezi-3 noma ezi-2 zingaphansi kwepizza eyodwa.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.prompt: Khetha isihlukanisi kusukela ku-3 kuya ku-9 bese wenza izingxenyana ezingafanele ezi-4 ezihlukene a/b ezingaphezulu kwepizza eyodwa futhi ezingaphansi kwamapizza amabili. (Isihlukanisi u-b nenombolo engaphezulu u-a.)
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha isihlukanisi bese uqala ngokubhala ukuthi ipizza eyodwa ihlukaniswe yaba yizingcezu ezingaki.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala inani lezingcezu epizza eyodwa nasemapizza amabili, bese ukhetha inombolo engaphezulu phakathi kwazo.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.hint.2: Kungxenyana ngayinye oyenzile, hlola ngokuqhathanisa inombolo engaphezulu nenani lezingcezu epizza eyodwa nasemapizza amabili.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Isihlukanisi yinombolo yemvelo kusukela ku-3 kuya ku-9.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Sicela wenze u-b abe yinombolo yemvelo kusukela ku-3 kuya ku-9.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Inombolo engaphezulu inkulu kunesihlukanisi, ngakho ingaphezulu kwepizza eyodwa.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Kumele ibe ngaphezulu kwepizza eyodwa. Inombolo engaphezulu kumele ibe nkulu kunesihlukanisi (inani lezingcezu epizza eyodwa).
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Kumele ibe ngaphansi kwamapizza amabili. Inombolo engaphezulu kumele ibe mincane kuno-2 izikhathi zenani lezingcezu epizza eyodwa.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.explain: Uma isihlukanisi singu-b, ipizza eyodwa ingu-b izingcezu. Uma inombolo engaphezulu inkulu kuno-b futhi incane kuno-2b, ihlangabezana nezimo. n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.prompt: Phakathi kwezingxenyana ezinesihlukanisi u-6, zingaki sebezonke ezingaphezulu kwepizza eyodwa futhi ezingaphansi kwamapizza amabili?
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala izingxenyana ezinesihlukanisi u-6 ngokulandelana, ngezinombolo ezingaphezulu kusukela ku-5 kuya ku-13.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.hint.1: Susa lezo ezingu-ncamashi ipizza eyodwa nezingu-ncamashi amapizza amabili, bese ubala ezisele.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.r.a: Lokhu kucabanga kubale ingxenyana eyodwa engeziwe esemkhawulweni, noma ipizza eyodwa noma amapizza amabili.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.r.b: Lokhu kucabanga kubale ngisho nezingxenyana ezilingana nepizza eyodwa namapizza amabili.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.r.c: Lokhu kucabanga kuphutshe ingxenyana eyodwa ehlangabezana nesimo. Bhala izinombolo ezingaphezulu ngokulandelana uqale kulezo ezinkulu kuno-6.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.r.d: Lokhu kucabanga kushiye imikhawulo futhi kwabala yonke inombolo engaphezulu eyaphakathi kwayo.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.explain: Zi-5, ezinezinombolo ezingaphezulu 7, 8, 9, 10, no-11. U-6/6 ungu-ncamashi ipizza eyodwa no-12/6 ungu-ncamashi amapizza amabili, ngakho awafakiwe.
